notes: PTW public specifications give sensitive radius 3.05 mm, length 23.0 mm, 0.335 mm PMMA plus 0.09 mm graphite wall, and a 1.15 mm diameter Al central electrode.
The public 23 mm length and 3.05 mm radius do not geometrically reproduce the nominal 0.6 cm3 volume when represented as a simple straight cylinder.

Published Monte Carlo work by Puxeu Vaque et al. reports nominal internal cavity volume 637.1 mm3, central-electrode volume 22.02 mm3 and net cavity volume 615.1 mm3 for PTW 30013. Model A constrains the straight cylindrical representation to those aggregate volumes.
This is not a manufacturer blueprint. Stem, guard and detailed tip geometry are intentionally excluded from Model A and will be treated as a later model-sensitivity term.
